simple.meaning: תַּרְבִּית (tarbîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “multiplication , i.e. percentage or bonus in addition to principal.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: תַּרְבִּית (H8636) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 25:36, with occurrences in Leviticus, Proverbs, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to תַּרְבִּית (H8636) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in תַּרְבִּית (H8636) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: תַּרְבִּית (tarbîyth) / H8636 is traced through Leviticus 25:36, Proverbs 28:8, Ezekiel 18:8, Ezekiel 18:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
